name: Pramlintide
description: A synthetic analogue of the beta-cell hormone amylin, given with mealtime insulin in type 1 and type 2 diabetes to slow gastric emptying and suppress glucagon.

systems.note: Amylin receptor agonism suppressing postprandial glucagon; the intended site of action.

monitors.why: Severe hypoglycaemia with insulin is the labelled boxed risk.
